summary: Frontend-only verification of Next Level Gaming Events navbar re-layout + regression on lenticular carousel. All 8 requested checks pass on Desktop (1920x1080) and Mobile (390x844). CONTACT is correctly placed in the centre nav group between ABOUT and the right-side CTA cluster; right side contains only the GET A QUOTE split CTA (plus the lg:hidden hamburger); EVENTS mega shows exactly 3 items and EXPERIENCE crossfades to exactly 5 items with no spotlight/Crowd Favourite card; nav island is lighter (#141b2e) than the page background (#05070f) with visible concave fillets and a subtle white stroke via --nav-stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.22); mobile accordion opens EVENTS (3) and EXPERIENCE (5) and CONTACT appears as a normal row; the Choose Your Experience lenticular carousel renders 5 cards + 5 dots and the next arrow advances the active dot as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx: In the mobile accordion, all megaMenus items for every accordion are always rendered in the DOM (max-h/opacity toggles visibility only). This is not a bug but duplicates data-testids in the DOM when both accordions are open; if tests need to assert only-visible items, they must check computed height/visibility rather than querying by data-testid alone.

Navbar.jsx: header uses onMouseLeave=scheduleClose at the <header> level — this fires when moving from the trigger down into the mega panel edge; mitigated by clearTimeout on mega-panel onMouseEnter. Works but is fragile; consider tying open state to a single container hover.
index.css: nav-hairline has width 1920 but --nav-stroke uses rgba white 0.22 — very subtle on the #141b2e strip; visually visible in screenshot but low contrast which is intentional per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://visual-markup-tool-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Nav testids: site-navbar, nav-trigger-events, nav-trigger-experience, mega-panel, mega-item-<kebab>, nav-quote-cta, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-accordion-<key>, mobile-mega-item-<kebab>. Note: mobile-mega-item-* testids are always present in DOM for both accordions regardless of open state (visibility controlled by max-h/opacity); use bounding rect height > 0 or ancestor .max-h-0 check if asserting visibility. The .carousel-3d-card marquee items intentionally overflow horizontally and are clipped by overflow-hidden — exclude from overflow checks. Nav overflow check confirmed doc scrollWidth == innerWidth (1920), so navbar contributes no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported navbar issues (CONTACT placement, broken-looking curves, missing white stroke) are resolved. Nav bg (#141b2e) sits above page bg (#05070f), concave fillet spans (.nav-notch-l/r) plus arc borders (.nav-arc) render the curved joins with the white hairline stroke visible in both left (x 240-720) and right (x 1200-1680) crops.
